title: Nellewyn
description: Nellewyn is a cozy, whimsical modpack focused on atmosphere, immersion, and aesthetics ⋆.°
body:
Nellewyn is a cozy, whimsical modpack focused on atmosphere, immersion, and aesthetics ⋆.°

It preserves the vanilla spirit while adding a subtle touch of magic, along with decorative details and richer flora and fauna. 🌱

Walk through forests, explore open plains, and enjoy ambient soundscapes that immerse you in a world that feels alive and natural!

Created by Nelle ♡
Feedback & support: @cosynelle (Instagram)
